title: God Himself Is Present
description: God Himself Is Present in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 3 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Gerhard Tersteegen, first published in 1729. The English translation is by Frederick William Foster and John Miller (1789). The tune, WUNDERBARER KÖNIG, is by Joachim Neander (1680). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: God Him-self is pre-sent: Let us now a-dore Him, And with awe ap-pear be-fore Him. God is in His tem-ple, all with-in keep si-lence, Pro-strate lie with deep-est rev-erence. Him a-lone God we own, Him our God and Sa-vior; Praise His name for-ev-er.

lines: And with awe appear before Him.
See the crowds the throne surrounding!
Bow Thine ear to us here:
